# nginx additions for the SEO layer — rentpondy.com
#
# Verified against the live VPS on 2026-07-22:
#   nginx 1.26.1, no Apache. Node listening on *:5005 (pm2 process "server").
#   Real nginx.conf : /usr/local/nginx/conf/nginx.conf   (compiled from source)
#   which includes  : /etc/nginx/availablesites/*.conf
#
# >>> THE FILE TO EDIT IS:  /etc/nginx/availablesites/rentpondy.com.conf  <<<
#
#   That file holds BOTH the port-80 redirect and the live `listen 443 ssl`
#   server block (the one containing `location /PPC/`).
#
#   Do NOT edit /etc/nginx/availablesites/ssl_rentpondy.com.conf — it declares a
#   second 443 block for the same server_name, so nginx already ignores it:
#       nginx: [warn] conflicting server name "rentpondy.com" on 0.0.0.0:443, ignored
#   (That warning predates this change. Leave it alone; it is not ours to fix.)
#
# WHAT THIS DOES
#   Sends five path patterns to Node instead of the static React build:
#       /robots.txt                    crawl rules + sitemap pointer
#       /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-*.xml   generated fresh from MongoDB
#       /property/...                  server-rendered property pages
#       /rent/...                      server-rendered landing pages
#   Everything else is untouched: /, /pondicherry, /detail/123, /process/,
#   /PPC/... all keep behaving exactly as they do today.
#
# WHY THE UPSTREAM IS [::1]:5005
#   Matching the existing `location /PPC/` block, which is proven working on this
#   box. Node binds *:5005 so 127.0.0.1 would work too — no reason to differ.
#
# WHY NO TRAILING SLASH ON proxy_pass
#   The existing /PPC/ block uses `proxy_pass http://[::1]:5005/;` WITH a slash,
#   which strips the /PPC prefix (that is why the app's API base is
#   .../PPC/PPC/...). Our blocks must pass the FULL path through, so they have
#   NO trailing slash. Do not "tidy" one to match the other.
#
# WHY ^~ ON /property/ AND /rent/
#   This server block ends with a regex location:
#       location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg)$
#   A plain prefix match loses to a later regex match; `^~` stops regex
#   evaluation once the prefix matches. Also note `/property-map` (a React route)
#   does NOT start with `/property/`, so it is unaffected.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# STEP 1 — back up
#
#   ssh rentpondy
#   sudo cp /etc/nginx/availablesites/rentpondy.com.conf \
#           /root/rentpondy.com.conf.bak-$(date +%F)
#
# STEP 2 — edit
#
#   sudo nano /etc/nginx/availablesites/rentpondy.com.conf
#
#   Scroll to the end of the `location /PPC/ { ... }` block — it closes with `}`
#   on its own line, immediately before the comment `# Security headers`.
#   Paste everything between the two markers below on the blank line in between.
#
#   (nano: Ctrl+O then Enter to save, Ctrl+X to exit.)
#
# STEP 3 — test.  MUST print "syntax is ok" AND "test is successful".
#
#   sudo nginx -t
#
#   Two pre-existing "conflicting server name ... ignored" warnings are normal
#   and were there before this change. Any NEW error: do not reload, undo STEP 2.
#
# STEP 4 — apply.  Zero downtime; in-flight requests are allowed to finish.
#
#   sudo systemctl reload nginx
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── paste from here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    # ===== SEO layer (PPC/Seo/) =====

    # Crawl rules, generated from the live listings.
    location = /robots.txt {
        proxy_pass         http://[::1]:5005;
        proxy_set_header   Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header   X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # Sitemap index. Rebuilt from MongoDB, so properties uploaded today appear
    # here today.
    location = /sitemap.xml {
        proxy_pass         http://[::1]:5005;
        proxy_set_header   Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header   X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # Child sitemaps: -pages, -locations, -properties-1, -properties-2, ...
    location ~ ^/sitemap-[a-z0-9\-]+\.xml$ {
        proxy_pass         http://[::1]:5005;
        proxy_set_header   Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header   X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # Server-rendered property pages, e.g.
    #   /property/3691/2-bhk-house-for-rent-in-kurumbapet-pondicherry
    location ^~ /property/ {
        proxy_pass         http://[::1]:5005;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header   Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header   X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 30s;
    }

    # Server-rendered landing pages, e.g.
    #   /rent/pondicherry
    #   /rent/pondicherry/apartment
    #   /rent/chennai/apartment/mylapore
    location ^~ /rent/ {
        proxy_pass         http://[::1]:5005;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header   Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header   X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 30s;
    }

    # ===== end SEO layer =====

# ── to here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# STEP 5 — verify (run from your PC, or in a browser)
#
#   curl -sI https://rentpondy.com/sitemap.xml | head -1
#       -> HTTP/2 200
#
#   curl -s https://rentpondy.com/robots.txt | tail -2
#       -> Sitemap: https://rentpondy.com/sitemap.xml
#
#   curl -s https://rentpondy.com/rent/pondicherry/apartment | grep -o '<h1>.*</h1>'
#       -> <h1>Apartment for Rent in Pondicherry</h1>
#
#   curl -sI https://rentpondy.com/property/3691 | head -2
#       -> HTTP/2 301  +  location: /property/3691/2-bhk-house-for-rent-in-...
#
#   MUST STILL WORK (nothing may regress):
#   curl -sI https://rentpondy.com/                | head -1   -> 200 React app
#   curl -sI https://rentpondy.com/pondicherry     | head -1   -> 200 React app
#   curl -sI https://rentpondy.com/detail/3691     | head -1   -> 200 React app
#   curl -s  https://rentpondy.com/PPC/PPC/health              -> {"status":"OK"...}
#
# ROLLBACK (any problem, ~5 seconds)
#
#   sudo cp /root/rentpondy.com.conf.bak-$(date +%F) \
#           /etc/nginx/availablesites/rentpondy.com.conf
#   sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
